caption: The drawing consists of two black line illustrations on an off-white background with a thin rectangular border. The upper illustration shows a top-down view of a round, flat object with evenly spaced small black holes arranged in concentric circles. On one side of this round object, there is a short, wide rectangular extension, and on the opposite side is a decorative handle featuring a scalloped edge and a small, circular detail at the end. The lower illustration is a side view of the same object, displaying its shallow half-spherical shape with a flat rim, the pattern of holes, and a straight handle extending from one side. The drawing is monochrome, featuring only black ink lines and dots on a lightly yellowed sheet. There is a small handwritten signature in the bottom right corner.
title: Silver Punch Strainer
